instructions: 1. Say to your AI: "Pull the posts I bookmarked on X into my own records", and give it nothing more: every input is optional.
2. The AI calls run_resource_operation at @workshop-tools with method tools:run, tool tool:pull-my-x-bookmarks and its input (the worked example shows one).
3. Read what comes back: Reads your bookmarks (newest first; needs a token with the bookmark.read, tweet.read and users.read scopes) and keeps each in your records.
4. It reads and writes only its own rows through the records door: account-snapshot-part (records:list, records:write).
